notes.title: Tutorial and Fixes
notes.content:
[b]DEMO UPDATE[/b]

[b]ADDED[/b]

[list]
[*]Simple tutorial to teach bunny-hopping
[*]Mousewheel selection for weapons
[*]Vsync option
[*]More resolution options
[*]End Level screen with timer and killcount
[*]The ability to see weapon inventory with "Q"
[/list]

[b]FIXED[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed Invert Mouse being mixed up
[*]Fixed Recoil throwing aim off
[*]Fixed Settings not saving
[*]Changed vision modes to use "E" instead of "R"
[*]Made final elevator in level 1 more visible
[*]Minor balancing on health packs
[/list]

notes.title: New Level, New Gun
notes.content:
[list]
[*]New Level

[*]New Weapon Available

[*]Save System

[*]Boss has been removed because he wasn't very fun to fight

[*]New vision modes

[*]Old HUD made a comeback as well as the ability to turn off all HUD

[*]Cycle the vision modes and HUDs with "Q" and "R"
[/list]

The release of the game has been delayed so i will try to update the demo more frequently until i can give an accurate estimate of when episode 1 will be ready, thank you for sticking around and for all the feedback.
